head: a1ed25f95980980cd958044b90e739ac45e8280d
decisionBasis: Binding Todo 15 user-started-focus requirement fails on current product bytes: the browser is the only Start surface, and a direct real-Chromium Start-to-authoritative-starting transition leaves focus on BODY while #btn-live-stop is visible. Focus trapping itself is repaired and passes.

results.browserDialogFocusTrap: PASS: 14 pass / 0 fail across four dialogs, both wrap directions, Escape restoration, closed-dialog exclusion, and residue guard
results.browserStartToStopFocus: FAIL_PRODUCT_DEFECT: outbound startCapture observed; live Stop visible; activeElement BODY; Stop not focused
results.installedNativeAnnouncements: EXPLICIT_PLATFORM_OBSERVATION_LIMITATION: product observer and known-good AppKit control post were both invisible to external AXObserver; runtime delivery remains unproven
results.installedNativeStopFocus: UNRESOLVED_EVIDENCE_GAP_OR_POSSIBLE_DEFECT: source requests focus but installed AX state remained on window; attribute was externally observable/settable
results.nativeReadableTextContrast: DERIVED_PASS: normal text 14.94:1 Aqua / 12.23:1 Dark Aqua; provisional text 5.59:1 / 6.64:1
results.nativeFocusIndicatorContrast: EXPLICIT_LIMITATION: semantic-color composition 2.15:1 Aqua / 2.57:1 Dark Aqua is below 3:1, but this is not a rendered AppKit focus-bezel pixel measurement
results.canonicalViewportReceipts: PASS_WITH_EXPLICIT_RECEIPT_LIMITATION: all dimensions exist and checksum; repair captures observed library at all six sizes. Actual live 960/820/375 comes from Todo 19 receipts, with current live behavior covered by fresh tests. Repair files named live are not live-shell proof.

verification.focusTrapCommand: bun test tests/public-caret-accessibility.test.ts --test-name-pattern 'every shipped dialog traps'
